body.x: GYEONGGI, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2007') -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics presented its UCC camcorder ‘VP-MX10A’ during KES 2007, which records to SD/SDHC/MMC+ cards or 4 GB of built-in flash memory. It also includes 3D Noise Reduction Filter technology allowing it to produce realistic, vivid images. The Hyper Image Stabilizer feature, along with the compact palm size of the camcorder, help stabilize any hand movements during recording. It comes with four different colors such as black, white, purple and pink, and suggested price is between 300,000(KRW) and 400,000(KRW).
